## About
M&M Motorwerk is a small European car shop on Soo Line Lane in Schiller Park. We handle preventive maintenance, diagnosis and repairs for European cars, sports and exotic vehicles, and BMW and Porsche are the cars we care about most.
Unlike big shops and dealers, we like to deal with you one on one and build a relationship that lasts. Stop by, give us a call, or send an email with any question about your car. We speak English, Polish, Russian and Bulgarian.
Owners who have come to us talk about Marin's honesty, his knowledge of German cars, and fair pricing. We hold a 4.6 rating from 43 Google reviews.

## Services
- European car diagnosis and repair: Diagnosis and repairs for all European cars, including sports and exotic cars.
- Preventative maintenance: Regular maintenance to keep your European car running the way it should.
- Engine, transmission and differential work: Overhauls, upgrades and performance work on engines, transmissions and differentials.

## FAQ
Q: What cars do you work on?
A: We specialize in BMW and Porsche, and we work on European cars and trucks in general.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM. We are closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We are on Soo Line Lane in Schiller Park, 3 blocks off Irving Park Road and River Road.
